verses.english: Untitled Discourses on the Eye, Etc.

verses.pali: Ekādasahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako bhabbo gogaṇaṁ pariharituṁ phātikātuṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, a cowherd with eleven factors can maintain and expand a herd of cattle.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, gopālako rūpaññū hoti… pe…
verses.english: It’s when a cowherd knows form …

verses.pali: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhabbo cakkhusmiṁ aniccānupassī viharituṁ…
verses.english: In the same way, a mendicant with eleven qualities can meditate observing impermanence in the eye …
